location.description: iphone:// for the only connected device, or iphone://<udid>

device_id.description: UDID of the device to back up, an alternative to naming it in the location

working_directory.description: Directory the device backup is staged in and kept between runs for incremental backups; defaults to <user cache dir>/plakar/iphone

full_backup.description: Force a full backup instead of an incremental one

pairing_timeout.description: How long to wait for the Trust dialog to be accepted on the device
